Monologue: Fine night we are having here, friend. Shame you are unable to enjoy it.
I would say you are missing out, but for some reason, I don't believe that to be the case.
You are odder than most. More akin to our kind…but you are lacking the most important ingredient.
Your persistent silence leaves your customers at a loss; who knows if you truly care for their stories?
Your connection to this world should be insignificant, and yet, this place sees such mobility. People *trust* you.
Their hearts are slowly opening. Like a budding rose, softening to your light. Should I help them blossom to their fullest potential? Or do I refrain?
The final act of this city's decay is so near.
I am curious if your bizarre method of cooking could really save someone. Please do entertain me. The fun is only just beginning, friend.
